serve_glm_records_recipe:
Best way to serve GLM 5.3 Flash on two Sparks today: use the EXL3 quant. The thread reports ~2300 tok/s prefill and ~50 tok/s decode, with contexts up to 150k tokens.

Sources: https://forums.developer.nvidia.com/t/381350/854 ("The EXL3/python is the best GLM 5.3 flash for dual spark imho") and https://forums.developer.nvidia.com/t/381350/917 (the prefill/decode numbers).

Caveat: tool-call XML in the text channel can come back as plain content on the tensorfold stack, so agent clients may see empty replies and retry.
frontier_saves_note: Strongest models people run on two Sparks right now: GLM 5.3 Flash (EXL3) leads, with the only recorded dual-spark recipe and the best documented numbers — https://forums.developer.nvidia.com/t/381350/854 and https://forums.developer.nvidia.com/t/381350/917. Qwen3.8 Flash Next is the most talked-about model without a recorded recipe yet, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is tracked with little recent activity. No benchmark results are recorded yet, so this ranking rests on reported tok/s and thread activity.
